user_query: trass gmail that mentions shipBob or merchant or support and doesnt mention mgm, limit query to last 3 months

intent.goal: find gmail messages in trass workspace mentioning shipBob/merchant/support but excluding mgm within last 3 months

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.body_snippet,
    g.message_content,
    g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%merchant%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%merchant%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%merchant%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%support%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%support%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%support%'
)
AND LOWER(g.subject) NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND LOWER(g.body_snippet) NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND LOWER(g.message_content) NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND g.email_date >= datetime('now', '-3 months')
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200;
